name: image_to_image.v1
description: Transforms an RGB input image, optionally using a text prompt.

image.description: RGB image in planar CHW format with values normalized to [0, 1]. Channels are ordered as Red, Green, then Blue.

prompt.description: Optional text instruction describing the requested transformation.

image.description: Resulting RGB image in planar CHW format with values normalized to [0, 1]. Channels are ordered as Red, Green, then Blue.
